source: Host, host:port, or an https (or http) URL. The JMAP service is found at https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; the port is 443 unless given.
text: Host, host:port, na URL https (na http). Ny serivisy JMAP dia hita ao amin'ny https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; ny seranan-tsambo dia 443 raha tsy nomena.

source: Plain http: your password and mail travel unencrypted.
text: http tsotra: ny tenimiafinao sy ny mailakao dia tsy misy encryption.

source: This account cannot send: set an SMTP server or turn on Send over JMAP.
text: Tsy afaka mandefa ity kaonty ity: mametraka server SMTP na velomy ny Send over JMAP.

source: Cyrus SASL, Carnegie Mellon University license
text: Cyrus SASL, fahazoan-dàlana Carnegie Mellon University

source: Saves the current expansion as the default.
text: Mitahiry ny fanitarana ankehitriny ho default.

source: Opens messages kept on this device.
text: Manokatra hafatra voatahiry amin'ity fitaovana ity.

source: Chooses which actions stay on the bar.
text: Mifidy izay hetsika mijanona eo amin'ny bar.
Ity lahatahiry ity dia manomboka mivelatra.

source: Selects every message in the list.
text: Mifidy ny hafatra rehetra ao anaty lisitra.
Esory ny hafatra voamarika fa voafafa.
Manokatra ny hafatra mbola tsy novakiana manaraka.

source: Marks the messages in this folder read.
text: Mariho ny hafatra ato amin'ity lahatahiry ity.

source: Shows the thread of the selected message.
text: Mampiseho ny kofehy amin'ny hafatra voafantina.

source: Saves the message without deleting it.
text: Mitahiry ny hafatra nefa tsy mamafa azy.

source: Copies an address from the message.
Starts a filter from this message.
text: Manomboka sivana avy amin'ity hafatra ity.

source: Shows the message with dark colors.
text: Mampiseho ny hafatra misy loko maizina.

source: Shows the message with its own colors.
text: Mampiseho ny hafatra miaraka amin'ny lokony.
Manakana ny sary avy amin'ity mpandefa ity.
Mamela sary avy amin'ity mpandefa ity.
Manakana sary avy amin'ity lisitra ity.
Mamela sary avy amin'ity lisitra ity.

source: Saves the message to send later.
text: Mitahiry ny hafatra halefa any aoriana.

source: Adds or removes this folder as a favorite.
text: Manampy na manala ity lahatahiry ity ho ankafizina.

source: Shows the message in this view.
text: Mampiseho ny hafatra amin'ity fijery ity.
Mampiasa ity adiresy ity ho Avy.

source: Uses this field in the query.
text: Mampiasa an'ity saha ity amin'ny fanontaniana.

source: Limits the list to this criterion.
text: Mametra ny lisitra amin'ity fepetra ity.

source: Marks the selection seen or unseen.
text: Manamarika ny safidy hita na tsy hita.
saina na manala saina ny safidy.

source: Allow old TLS and weak keys
text: Avelao ny TLS taloha sy ny fanalahidy malemy
Avelao ny tenimiafina misy soratra mazava

source: Move entire folder includes deleted messages
text: Afindrao ny lahatahiry manontolo dia misy hafatra voafafa

source: When a pinerc has no incoming-startup-rule
text: Rehefa tsy manana fitsipika fanombohana miditra ny pinerc
Maka isa ho an'ny lahatahiry hita (miadana kokoa)

text: Aza manontany indray ny amin'ity fihemorana ity
Elanelan'ny fitsapan-kevitra rehefa tsy nahomby ny IDLE
Avereno indray ny IDLE isaky ny
elanelam-potoana maharitra (NOOP amin'ny fifandraisana tsy miasa)

text: Aza manontany indray ity fikarohana ity

text: Ny kaonty dia misokatra ao amin'ny vatasarihana

text: Tsy azo novakiana ny fika ho an'ny %1$s. Hitohy ny famafana.

text: Mitovy amin'ny mpizara miditra sy miditra

source: Google restore isn't available in this build; passwords are not backed up
text: Google restore dia tsy misy amin'ity fananganana ity; ny tenimiafina dia tsy averina averina

text: Google famerenana dia mila hidin'ny efijery

source: The password backup is too large
These stored keys are not in this version. Remove them?
text: Tsy ao anatin'ity dikan-teny ity ireo fanalahidy voatahiry ireo. Esory izy ireo?

text: Nesorina ny kaonty default. Mifidiana kaonty.

text: Tsy azo novakiana ny firafitry ny kaonty.
